desc: Derive correct decomposition: total = |S|·Σ_{i∉S} C_i·A_i + Σ_{k∈S} C_k·f(k,p_k) where f = (p−1) for A=1→0 flips and (|S|−p+1) for A=0→1 flips; adjacent-swap argument shows all A=1 mismatches go first, then A=0 mismatches.
Final formula: baseline |S|·Σ_{i∉S,A_i=1} C_i + Σ d_k·k (A=1 group sorted desc) + Σ e_k·(m0−k) (A=0 group sorted asc); verified on Sample 1 → 16.
Implement corrected O(N log N) Python solution with fast I/O; hand-check Sample 1 (16), Sample 2 (0), and edge cases (empty groups, single-element S).

Brute-force validate against all flip permutations for small random N (N≤8, 3000 trials, all agree) and reason through Sample 3 (manual arithmetic error-prone, but formula path identical to validated cases).
